say:1:1460201001:1.text: Master, a-are you sure this is the right place for an adventure? Chippy's getting chills down the spine for some reason...
say:1:1460201001:1.source_cn: 主人，这里真的适合探险吗？不知道为什么，我感觉脖子后面...
say:1:1460201001:1.male: Master, a-are you sure this is the right place for an adventure? Chippy's getting chills down the spine for some reason...
say:1:1460201001:1.female: Master, a-are you sure this is the right place for an adventure? Chippy's getting chills down the spine for some reason...

say:2:1460201002:1.source_cn: 好像有什么东西在盯着我们……

say:3:1460201003:1.text: S-Same! This eerie vibe's giving me goosebumps!
say:3:1460201003:1.source_cn: 我、我也是，好像有奇怪的气息，我的毛毛都炸开了！

choice_prompt:4:1460201003.text: S-Same! This eerie vibe's giving me goosebumps!
choice_prompt:4:1460201003.source_cn: 我、我也是，好像有奇怪的气息，我的毛毛都炸开了！

say:5:1460201004:4.text: Shuffling footsteps echo from deep within the mine, and a slender Essail priestess slowly emerges from the darkness.
say:5:1460201004:4.source_cn: 矿洞深处传来沙沙的脚步声，一个身材瘦削的艾塞勒祭司从黑...

say:6:1460201005:0.text: Her steps are unsteady as if she is in a trance. The ores cast a bluish light over her veiled features, stirring a sense of dread.
say:6:1460201005:0.source_cn: 她的步伐不稳，似乎处于一种特殊的状态。幽蓝色的矿物光芒...

say:8:1460201006:1.text: Who's there?! How dare you trespass here!

say:10:1460201007:1.text: Master, this lady... doesn't seem right in the head. Chippy's scared!
say:10:1460201007:1.source_cn: 主人，这个人看起来……不太正常。满满有点害怕！
say:10:1460201007:1.male: Master, this lady... doesn't seem right in the head. Chippy's scared!
say:10:1460201007:1.female: Master, this lady... doesn't seem right in the head. Chippy's scared!

say:12:1460201008:1.text: Sorry for the intrusion! We're just travelers, and we mean no harm. If our presence bothers you, we don't mind leaving right away...
say:12:1460201008:1.source_cn: 不好意思，打扰了。我们是来此探险的旅行者，并没有冒犯之...

say:13:1460201009:1.text: Travelers? Don't lie to me! I know you're here to steal the Divine Dew!
say:13:1460201009:1.source_cn: 探险？不、不、你们是来窃取我们珍贵的恩典灵露的！

say:14:1460201010:2.text: You can't fool me, you filthy toplanders!
say:14:1460201010:2.source_cn: 你们的谎言无法欺骗我！你们是污秽的地表人！

say:15:1460201011:2.text: With the power of the Divine Dew, I shall purify these toplanders...
say:15:1460201011:2.source_cn: 恩典之源，予我之力，净化这些地表人——

say:16:1460201012:2.source_cn: 满满、主人，她在施法，快躲开！
